sql: SELECT "Properties"."property_id" AS k, (CAST("Properties"."agreed_selling_price" AS REAL) / "Properties"."room_count") AS m1 FROM "Properties" WHERE (CAST("Properties"."agreed_selling_price" AS REAL) / "Properties"."room_count") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Properties.agreed selling price per number of rooms
why: agreed selling price / number of rooms: the catalogue declares agreed selling price a rate over number of rooms
rank Properties rows by agreed selling price per number of rooms

sql: SELECT "Properties"."property_id" AS k, (CAST("Properties"."buyer_offered_price" AS REAL) / "Properties"."vendor_requested_price") AS m1 FROM "Properties" WHERE (CAST("Properties"."buyer_offered_price" AS REAL) / "Properties"."vendor_requested_price") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Properties.price offered by buyer relative to price requested by vendor
why: price offered by buyer / price requested by vendor: a ratio of two quantities in USD
rank Properties rows by price offered by buyer relative to price requested by vendor

sql: SELECT "Properties"."property_id" AS k, ("Properties"."agreed_selling_price" - "Properties"."vendor_requested_price") AS m1 FROM "Properties" WHERE ("Properties"."agreed_selling_price" - "Properties"."vendor_requested_price") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Properties.agreed selling price minus price requested by vendor
why: agreed selling price - price requested by vendor: both in USD and of the same kind (same additivity) on the same property listing
rank Properties rows by agreed selling price minus price requested by vendor

sql: SELECT "Properties"."property_id" AS k, ("Properties"."agreed_selling_price" - "Properties"."buyer_offered_price") AS m1 FROM "Properties" WHERE ("Properties"."agreed_selling_price" - "Properties"."buyer_offered_price") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Properties.agreed selling price minus price offered by buyer
why: agreed selling price - price offered by buyer: both in USD and of the same kind (same additivity) on the same property listing
rank Properties rows by agreed selling price minus price offered by buyer
